Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Revolut's investing intro carousel - swiping morphs between 3D metallic illustrations (stacked cubes for "BUILD YOUR WEALTH", a metallic ring for "TAILOR YOUR PORTFOLIO", floating cards for "ENJOY 0% COMMISSION") over a mint gradient with a segmented progress indicator.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light mint-gradient screen: top nav with avatar and icons, a centered 3D chrome illustration, all-caps headline with a "Capital at risk" subline, an outlined "Start investing" pill, and two info rows below; bottom tab bar. Three pages, one per value prop.

## Motion spec
Pattern: metallic 3D carousel, ~450ms.
- Swipe: the current illustration rotates on its vertical axis as it exits (0 -> 90deg) while shrinking (1 -> 0.8) and fading; the next enters mirrored (-90deg -> 0) with a slow settle spin (spring ~280/18).
- Text: the headline crossfades with a 12px rise (250ms, +80ms behind the illustration); the subline follows +80ms.
- Progress: the segmented indicator advances with the active segment filling left-to-right (300ms).
- Idle: the current illustration slowly rotates (+-8deg sway, 3s) with moving specular highlights.

## Calibration
- Illustrations are chrome/metallic - highlights must move during every rotation.
- The mint gradient background is constant; only the illustration and text change.

## Reduced motion
Illustrations crossfade without rotation (250ms); no idle sway.

## Don't miss
- The 90deg edge-on midpoint makes the swap feel like a card flip, not a slide.
- "Capital at risk" appears under every headline, same position.
